people.name: Demetrius
people.line: Silversmith who opposed Paul in Ephesus

translations.web: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,
translations.bsb: It began with a silversmith named Demetrius who made silver shrines of Artemis, bringing much business to the craftsmen.
